newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS sees ROE rising to 12 percent.
newsitem.headline: UBS sees ROE rising to 12 percent.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it expects its return on equity to increase to around 12 percent by 1999 as the result of measures to be taken as part of a domestic restructuring programme.

"From 1997 onwards, provisions will no longer be such a constraint on group earnings, so that the group return on equity can be expected to steadily increase to around 12 percent by 1999," UBS said in a statement.
The group's return on equity was 7.5 percent in 1995.
The UBS restructuring plan calls for a special 3.0 billion Swiss franc charge to cover furture developments of credit risks in its domestic portfolio. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
